picks.what: Bird’s-eye view from the east, engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 1
picks.why: true bird’s-eye view of the first edition; cathedral and town hall recognizable (later editions replaced it with the 1576 plan)

picks.what: View of the walled city, engraving after Matthäus Merian in Martialischer Schau-Platz des Rhein-Strohms
picks.why: clear profile view with the cathedral at center; title and fold crease at top trimmed off

picks.file: Gezicht op Aken Vue générale d'Aix-la-Chapelle (titel op object), RP-P-2018-924.jpg
picks.who: Hilaire Antoine Kreins and Jean Baptiste Madou after Jean Nicolas Ponsart
picks.why: titled general view; city with its towers in the middle distance, high resolution

picks.file: General view, Aachen, the Rhine, Germany-LCCN2002714133.jpg
picks.why: color panorama from a height with the cathedral and town hall; border and caption trimmed

picks.what: Theaterstraße with the cathedral and town hall towers, postcard
picks.why: street view down to the cathedral and town hall skyline; handwriting and printed caption trimmed

gaps: P0: nothing; P6: only details and interiors of the cathedral, no general view
notes: #23 is dated from the postcard (likely its postmark), so the photo may be a few years older; #21 (1931 aerial, hazy and marked in red pencil) is the alternative for P5. #8 (Coumont engraving) skipped because it is only dated ‘17th century’. #7 is a 1652 reissue of the 1576 plan, a plan rather than a view.
